preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range of 1 to n.
Each query vertex v_i is within the range of 1 to n.
Each query distance d_i is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
Each query value x_i is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of n integers
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of n integers, where the i-th integer represents the value written on the i-th vertex after processing all queries.

invariants.description: The given graph is guaranteed to be a tree, meaning it is connected and has no cycles.
